author: Xufen Tu
title: 不要为了数据好看，失去真实的自己
observation: As communication, emotion, and interpersonal reactions become recorded and interpretable as data, people may feel pressure to perform stability, kindness, or pleasing behavior for future evaluation.
current_judgment: A person should take responsibility for expression without performing false kindness or losing authenticity in order to satisfy records, systems, or data interpretation.
boundary: Records should not define a person's whole identity, and data pressure should not force people to suppress real feelings, boundaries, or authentic judgment.
